instruction: Navigate to the news articles section on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the news articles section on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'justice.gov/news' using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains similar structure and difficulty as the original task, changing from browsing forms to browsing news articles.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from Chrome accessibility tree via get_active_url_from_accessTree
Metric properly uses regex pattern matching to verify 'justice.gov/news' appears in the URL
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (navigate to news section)
Expected value 'justice\.gov/news' correctly identifies the news articles section URL pattern
Logic will work correctly at runtime - getter and metric are well-implemented with proper error handling
No postconfig needed - URL state persists in address bar after navigation
